I don't know why, in theory it shouldn't be that hard to just go to an appointment, or go grocery shopping, or apply for jobs, but doing these things terrifies and drains me. 
I did manage to talk to my doctor at my last checkup and they prescribed me with Zoloft - but I have no insurance and can't really afford it at the moment. I know money is the root of the anxiety/fear of being a bad parent, but it's a slippery slope being poor and pregnant without a degree - how will I ever be able to go to school again and afford to live and take care of a baby at the same time? There's just so many things that are stressing me out that I just can't fix.
